lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Ca2 (Mg6Ca) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with 12 Mg neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers exhibit 12- and 16-neighbor environments, with Mg–Mg distances from about 3.01 to 3.60 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is fully three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12- and 16-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra, and between 12-vertex Mg and Ca polyhedra.
